auc.title: Auctions

auc.help_time: Times are in {tz}. A bid in the last 2 minutes extends the auction automatically.
auc.create_order_hint: An order is created for the winner: total = final price, status = awaiting advance. A confirmed deposit counts as payment.

hint.title: How the panel works
hint.intro: Every order moves through these stages. The system shows where it is; you only do the next step.
hint.step2: You confirm price and terms and send the offer
hint.step3: Customer pays the 30% advance and sends the receipt in chat; you enter the amount
hint.step5: Customer accepts the results and pays 70%

next.title: Next step
next.awaiting_admin: Check price, stock and terms, then send the customer an offer
next.awaiting_advance: Waiting for the 30% advance from the customer
next.advance_confirmed: Advance received — take the drives to testing
next.testing: Test the drives and mark them ready
next.test_ready: Send the results to the customer
next.awaiting_customer: Agree the results with the customer in chat
next.awaiting_balance: Waiting for the 70% balance from the customer
next.shipped: In transit — mark as delivered when it arrives
next.delivered: Customer received it — complete the order
next.disputed: Dispute — settle with the customer and make the final decision

nexthelp.new: The order has not been reviewed yet. Check items, price and delivery terms.
nexthelp.awaiting_admin: Adjust items and the final total, then press “Send offer”. The customer accepts it in the Mini App.
nexthelp.awaiting_advance: The customer sends the advance receipt in chat. Check the money arrived and enter it with “Record payment” — the status updates itself.
nexthelp.advance_confirmed: Press “Take to testing” — the customer is notified.
nexthelp.testing: Test the drives. When done, press the button below.
nexthelp.test_ready: After “Send results to customer” the customer is notified. Explain the results in chat.
nexthelp.awaiting_customer: If the customer accepts the results, press “Customer agreed” — the order moves to the balance payment.
nexthelp.awaiting_balance: The customer sends the balance receipt in chat. Enter the amount once it arrives. Nothing ships before full payment.
nexthelp.paid: Prepare the boxes and move the order to packing.
nexthelp.packing: Match the box with the cargo code and press the button below. The customer is notified.
nexthelp.shipped: When the shipment arrives mark “Delivered”. The customer is notified.
nexthelp.delivered: If there are no issues mark “Completed”.
nexthelp.disputed: Final decision: cancel, return or complete.
